scripts.install:mac: tauri build --bundles app && rm -rf /Applications/StudyTracker.app && ditto src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/StudyTracker.app /Applications/StudyTracker.app && echo 'Installed /Applications/StudyTracker.app'
scripts.release:mac: CI=true tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles app && mkdir -p release && rm -f release/StudyTracker-mac.zip && ditto -c -k --keepParent src-tauri/target/universal-apple-darwin/release/bundle/macos/StudyTracker.app release/StudyTracker-mac.zip && cp INSTALL.txt release/ && echo 'Send release/StudyTracker-mac.zip + release/INSTALL.txt'
scripts.release:web: npm run build && mkdir -p release && rm -f release/StudyTracker-web.zip && (cd dist && zip -qr ../release/StudyTracker-web.zip .) && echo 'Upload release/StudyTracker-web.zip contents to any static host'
scripts.release:win-web: npm run build && rm -rf release/StudyTracker-windows-web && mkdir -p release/StudyTracker-windows-web/app && cp -R dist/. release/StudyTracker-windows-web/app/ && cp windows-launcher/StudyTracker.cmd windows-launcher/serve.ps1 windows-launcher/README-Windows.txt release/StudyTracker-windows-web/ && rm -f release/StudyTracker-windows-web.zip && (cd release && zip -qr StudyTracker-windows-web.zip StudyTracker-windows-web) && echo 'Send release/StudyTracker-windows-web.zip'
